404 for a field that is not the user's; 422 with code `too_few_fields` when the

schema.title: Response Read Cards Api Cards Get

get.description:
The advisory preview behind every delete confirm: the same closure a deletion
transaction computes for itself, reported as counts. 404 for the first id that's
foreign or doesn't exist; 422 when all three lists are empty — there's nothing to
preview.

post.description:
404 naming a deck that is missing or not the user's; 400 `practice_name_taken` for a
name the user's other practice has; a plain 400 for no deck or a deck picked twice.

get.description: Most recently run first; a practice never run by when it was made.

schema.title: Response Get Practices Api Practices Get

get.description:
The name a practice of these decks, in this order, takes when created with none.
404 naming a deck that is missing or not the user's.

patch.description:
404 for an unknown or foreign practice; 400 `practice_name_taken` for a name the
user's other practice has; a plain 400 for a blank name.

delete.description:
Deletes the practice with its runs; the user's mastery stays. 404 for an unknown or
foreign practice.

post.description:
The practice's active run, or a new one when it has none. 404 for an unknown or
foreign practice; 400 `no_cards` when a new run would have no card.

get.description:
One server-composed payload. 404 for an unknown or foreign run; `current_card: null`
once nothing is pending, at which point `status` already reads "completed".

Everything the summary shows. 409 `run_active` while the run is active; 404 for an
unknown or foreign run.

post.description:
A new run of the whole practice of the completed run. 404 for an unknown or foreign
run; 400 `run_active`, `practice_has_active_run` or `no_cards`.

A new run of exactly the chosen cards of the completed run. 404 for an unknown or
foreign run; 400 `run_active`, `practice_has_active_run` or `no_cards`; a plain 400
for an empty list or a card the run did not hold.

get.description:
The one route without `CurrentUserDep`: the frontend's health probe must answer
signed-out visitors and must not depend on Clerk. 503
`database_unavailable` when the database does not answer.

BreakdownAttempt.title: BreakdownAttempt
BreakdownAttempt.description: One go at a card, by what it showed and what it asked.

BreakdownCard.title: BreakdownCard
BreakdownCard.description:
One card on the summary. `readiness` is the card's readiness after the run, from 0 to
1, over every live field of its deck, and `delta` that figure minus the same fold before
the run, so a field the run never showed or asked counts here though `fields` omits it.
`fields` is in field_def.position order; `attempts` is oldest first.

CardBatchCreate.title: CardBatchCreate
CardBatchCreate.description:
`values` is keyed by a real field_def id or a same-request `client_key`
(see `CardBatchUpdate`).

CardBatchUpdate.title: CardBatchUpdate
CardBatchUpdate.description:
`values` is partial (only changed fields), keyed by a real field_def id or a
same-request `client_key` — the deck editor's edit-mode diff can set an
existing card's value for a field created in the very same request (field
creates are always applied before card updates, per the stated operation order,
so the field already has a real row by the time this runs).

CardSummary.title: CardSummary
CardSummary.description: A card as a deck's page lists it.

DeckBatchEdit.title: DeckBatchEdit
DeckBatchEdit.description:
`PATCH /api/decks/{id}` body. Every top-level key is optional —
a request can touch just `name`, just `field_defs`, or any combination — but the
whole thing is applied as one transaction: a failure anywhere rolls back
everything, including an already-changed `name`.

DeckSummary.title: DeckSummary
DeckSummary.description:
A deck as a list row shows it. The single-deck reads
(`GET`/`POST`/`PATCH /api/decks/{id}`) return the richer `DeckDetail` instead, which
already includes everything here except card_count and field_names.

DeletionImpactRead.title: DeletionImpactRead
DeletionImpactRead.description:
The `GET /api/deletion-impact` response: the deletion closure's size, by type,
for a delete confirm to word its warning. Each
field is the count of one closure set `compute_deletion_impact` returns —
`cards_affected` is `DeletionImpact.affected_card_count`, every other field is
`len()` of the matching id set. Never nests another shape.

FieldDefBatchOps.title: FieldDefBatchOps
FieldDefBatchOps.description:
The `field_defs` changeset. Applied in the stated order (create → update →
delete → reorder) inside the batch-edit transaction — this model just carries the
four lists; the service resolves ids/client_keys and enforces the two-field floor.

FieldReadinessDelta.title: FieldReadinessDelta
FieldReadinessDelta.description:
One field an attempt of the run showed or asked: `readiness` is the field's readiness
after the run, from 0 to 1, and `delta` that readiness minus its readiness before the
run, exact.

FieldSide.title: FieldSide
FieldSide.description:
Where a card opened from the summary lists a field: `prompt` when any attempt showed
it, `answer` when attempts only asked it.

HomeSteps.title: HomeSteps
HomeSteps.description:
Whether the user has a deck and a card, the first two steps; the third, a
practice, never exists while the steps show.

RatedFieldValue.title: RatedFieldValue
RatedFieldValue.description:
A resolved answer field plus the rating it was given, joined from `review_log`
on `review_group_id == run_card.id` and `field_def_id`.

ResolvedFieldValue.title: ResolvedFieldValue
ResolvedFieldValue.description:
One prompt/answer field id from a run_card's `prompts`/`answers` array,
joined against its field_def (name, type) and this card's current value — the
server-side resolution every run payload uses instead of bare ids. `value` is `""`
when no card_field_value row exists for this (card, field) pair; it is passed
through as-is even if blank, since a value can go blank *after* the run_card was
generated (the blank filter governs generation-time candidacy, not later edits).

RunBreakdownRead.title: RunBreakdownRead
RunBreakdownRead.description:
The whole `GET /api/runs/{id}/breakdown` payload: every card and what the run did to
it, so the summary needs no second request. Only ever built for a completed run; the
router 409s an active one before this is composed.

RunProgress.title: RunProgress
RunProgress.description:
The live-progress counts: `total_cards` is fixed when the run is cut (distinct
card_ids that received a run_card row then) and never changes, so the other four
counts — a partition of it by chain-fold bucket — only ever redistribute, never grow
the denominator mid-run.

RunState.title: RunState
RunState.description:
The whole `GET /api/runs/{id}/state` payload — everything the run page needs to
render one screen, in one round trip. `current_card` is None once nothing is
pending, which is also exactly when `status` reads `completed`.

RunStatus.title: RunStatus
RunStatus.description:
Nothing records why a run stopped being active: finished and stranded by a
deletion both read as completed.
